description: Agent Evaluation: submit one evaluation run’s cost and latency figures with its stated budget: the total budget, the per-task cost cap, the task time cap and the percentile it applies to (median, 95th or slowest), the run’s task count, total cost and median, 95th percentile and slowest task times, each cost component (agent model calls, judge model calls, tool calls, compute, human review, storage or other) with its cost, and optionally each task’s cost and time. The signed report compares the total, the cost per task and the task time with the budget and caps, adds up the components against the total, and names a total over budget, tasks over the cost cap and task time over its cap, then every component with no cost, components that differ from the total by more than one part in a hundred, tasks with no recorded cost and single tasks over the time cap, with the fix for each. This reads one evaluation run’s cost against its own budget: an agent budget setup’s controls are wever_budget-controls-check, transactions against spending rules are wever_spending-anomaly-check and a forecast of spend is wever_budget-forecast-brief. Verdict over_budget, cost_gaps, cost_unverified or within_budget. POST /api/evaluation-cost-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-evaluation-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-evaluation/.

latency_basis.description: The time cap applies to the median, the 95th percentile or the slowest task.

latency_per_task.description: The time cap per task, such as 30 seconds.

total.description: The run budget, such as 500 USDC.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.
